modules.name: core
modules.purpose: HttpClient, retry/error handling, common types, pagination, signed uploads, and the link analytics + statistics types and query helpers shared by short-link and qr-code (4.4.0).

modules.name: short-link
modules.purpose: Short-link CRUD/list client. templateId required; androidUrl/iosUrl and isEnableLandingPage (S13); isEnableMonetization deprecated and stripped from every request; legacy pageinfo.title filter sent as pageInfo.title (4.3.0). getAnalytics(id, query?) and statistics(query?) (4.4.0, VA).

modules.name: qr-code
modules.purpose: Seven QR types with create/update/get/list/delete. Sends qrCodeTarget only; the API builds options.text (free text still sends it). isEnableMonetization deprecated and stripped; isEnableLandingPage on requests and list (4.3.0). getAnalytics(id, query?) and statistics(query?) (4.4.0, VA).

modules.name: social-publisher-workspace
modules.purpose: Workspace CRUD/list and signed logo upload.

modules.name: social-publisher-post
modules.purpose: Video/image publishing, upload orchestration, status and list.

modules.name: store
modules.purpose: Online Store management: products (incl. per-section saves, clone, Excel, AI), orders (incl. dropshipping parts), tags, customers, shipping and dropshipping suppliers. Split into six sub-clients on StoreClient. In the workspace and the publish workflow since 4.3.0.
